newsitem.title: CROATIA: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC, RUSEDSKI TO CLASH IN CROATIAN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC, RUSEDSKI TO CLASH IN CROATIAN FINAL.

text.p: Defending champion Goran Ivanisevic fired his 15th ace of the match to beat Javier Sanchez of Spain on Saturday for a place in the Croatian indoor tournament final.
Top seed Ivanisevic of Croatia ousted fifth-seeded Sanchez 6-2 6-4 and now faces Briton Greg Rusedski, who produced 16 aces in his surprise 6-4 6-4 victory over second seed Thomas Enqvist.
"I cannot play much better than I played in the semifinals. Whatever I hit, went in," Ivanisevic said.
In the other semifinal, Rusedski jumped in the air in delight after beating Enqvist, ranked 10th in the world.
"I was very excited. I've beaten only one top player last year, so I was very pleased to beat Thomas," Rusedski said. "I served unbelievably well today."
